usage: llm-modelbench runtime [-h] {discover,list,show,save,delete,select} ...

positional arguments:
  {discover,list,show,save,delete,select}
    discover            bounded read-only local runtime discovery
    list                list saved runtime profiles
    show                show one saved runtime profile
    save                save one external runtime profile
    delete              delete only one saved runtime profile
    select              select a healthy discovered runtime

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
